text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the thread in #central-random: the ticket for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing at Tansleigh Packaging is **#88412**.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 support escalation. The tablet was freezing on the bill-of-lading (BOL) barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself. In the reply I also pointed out that #8841, mentioned in #central-random yesterday, is a different ticket: Tobias's West yard Door 2 double-booking. That should keep the wrong one out of the tracker.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in the thread in #central-random: the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is on ticket **PD-4821**.
